metadata.title: FOLFOXIRI Therapy
metadata.indication: Metastatic colorectal cancer; every 14 days until progression or unacceptable toxicity.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

encoding_maturity.label: Source reconciled · independent clinical/pharmacy validation pending
encoding_maturity.scope_note: Current official source reconciled including clinical thresholds, component actions, phase and missing-data safeguards; independent clinical/pharmacy sign-off remains pending.

metadata.catalogue_source_check_scope: Catalogue presence and source link structure only; not rule level source fidelity.
metadata.schedule_summary: Day 1: irinotecan, oxaliplatin and folinic acid, followed by a 48-hour fluorouracil pump. Repeat every 14 days while treatment is helping and side effects remain acceptable.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: The treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Any dose modification should be discussed with a Consultant.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision support derived from NCCP 00555 v7. Current official regimen, prescribing review and independent clinical/pharmacy validation remain authoritative.

treatment_phases.name: FOLFOXIRI
treatment_phases.notes: No 5-FU bolus. Repeat until progression or unacceptable toxicity; consultant plans maintenance separately.
treatment_phases.label: FOLFOXIRI

rule_engine.conflict_policy: Use the most restrictive applicable action per component; do not sum reductions. Consultant review/source gaps must not produce automatic numeric doses. Prior reduced doses must never be re-escalated by a reference table.
rule_engine.missing_data_policy: Do not infer missing values, occurrence numbers, recovery, phase or current doses.

diarrhoea_grade.label: Current diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Count stools per day above the patient's baseline. Assess ostomy output, continence, hydration, fever, abdominal pain, sepsis and whether hospital care is indicated. Compare with the patient’s baseline stool/stoma output; record current versus worst episode grade, fever, neutropenia and occurrence separately.
diarrhoea_grade.source_grading_note: NCCP 00555 provides dose-management rows, not a complete grading table. CTCAE v 5.0 descriptions are a grading aid; source-specific dose thresholds, persistence and recurrence remain authoritative.

laryngopharyngeal_dysaesthesia.label: Laryngopharyngeal dysaesthesia: maintain oxaliplatin dose and extend infusion from 2 to 6 hours; distinguish from anaphylaxis.

acute_cholinergic_syndrome.label: Acute cholinergic syndrome: atropine 250 micrograms SC unless contraindicated; assess asthma/glaucoma and arrange subsequent prophylaxis.

glaucoma.label: Glaucoma: do not use source atropine premedication; pharmacy/consultant must select a suitable plan.

oxaliplatin_anaphylaxis.label: Oxaliplatin anaphylaxis: stop infusion, treat urgently, no oxaliplatin rechallenge.

hus_confirmed.label: Confirmed haemolytic uraemic syndrome: permanently discontinue oxaliplatin.

treatment.schedule_summary: Day 1: irinotecan, oxaliplatin and folinic acid, followed by a 48-hour fluorouracil pump. Repeat every 14 days while treatment is helping and side effects remain acceptable.

monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal/liver profile and DPD phenotype/genotype before first fluoropyrimidine (unless previously tested).
FBC, renal/liver profile before every cycle; assess peripheral neuropathy before proceeding.
ECG if compromised cardiac function / clinically relevant.
Disease assessment, imaging and tumour markers follow the consultant treatment plan; source does not mandate a universal scan interval.
eligibility: Source-listed indication; adequate haematological, renal and liver status.
ECOG≤2 for adults under70; ECOG<1 for71–75; age70 is unassigned and needs review.
dose_modifications: Use the source table for the specific event and treatment phase. Do not infer a unified ladder, add reductions, reset prior reduced components to full dose, or treat a blank source cell as a dose.
Every entered clinical value is assessed independently; missing phase, occurrence, recovery and current dose history remain unassessed or trigger review.
